title: Master Production Independent Verification & Release Certification
assignedTo: Remote Senior Staff Developer & Verification Lead
spec:
### 1. MISSION & FIRST-PRINCIPLES MANDATE
You are tasked with executing an autonomous, exhaustive, and completely independent end-to-end verification and release certification of the entire ResumePilotAI (IME365) platform.

CRITICAL MANDATE: ZERO TRUST IN PRIOR CLAIMS OR ARTIFACTS.
You must NOT rely on, assume, or accept any past test logs, generated census JSON files, or documentation summaries as proof of correctness. You must pull the clean codebase from the repository, configure the entire operational runtime locally on your machine, re-run every single test from first principles, inspect real DOM and live API responses with your own tools, and produce fresh, independent cryptographic evidence.

### 2. REMOTE TOOLING & RUNTIME SETUP REQUIREMENTS
You must setup and verify all required tooling in your remote environment:
1. Node.js runtime (v20.x or v22.x LTS) and npm package management.
2. Root dependencies: npm install (Vite, Tailwind v4, React 19, Lucide, Cuba design system).
3. Backend dependencies: npm --prefix backend install (Express, mysql2, dotenv, jsonwebtoken, crypto).
4. Playwright Browser Engines: npx playwright install --with-deps (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit).
5. Live Database Infrastructure: MariaDB/MySQL 10.5+ running on port 3306.
   - Database name: aime365 (or as configured in backend/.env).
   - Charset: utf8mb4 / Collation: utf8mb4_unicode_ci.
   - Execute all migrations in backend/database/migrations/ (001 through 024).
6. Environment configuration: Ensure .env and backend/.env are configured for local execution.

### 3. INDEPENDENT 8-STREAM DEEP VERIFICATION BATTERY
You must execute and prove 100% green pass rates (0 failures, 0 errors) across all 8 verification streams:

Stream 1: Security Static Sentinels & Canonical Discovery Policy
- Command: npm run test:security:static
- Target: 67 / 67 PASS (0 failures).
- Verification: Canonical Apache .htaccess headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, secret-scanner efficacy, XSS sanitization, MFA TOTP enrollment, unlayered-CSS isolation.

Stream 2: Live Database & Backend Integration Matrix
- Command: npm --prefix backend test
- Target: 892 / 892 PASS (0 failures) executed against live MariaDB 3306.
- Verification: Transactional outbox, AES-256-GCM envelope encryption, P0 TOTP MFA freshness checks, IDOR owner fences, rate limits, enterprise tenant isolation.

Stream 3: Frontend Product Suite Matrix
- Command: npm run test:product
- Target: 729 / 729 PASS (0 failures across all 58 product suites).
- Verification: Candidate workspace, recruiter ATS applicant pipeline, enterprise console modules, admin command center, resume builder 11-step completion, zero-fabrication assertions.

Stream 4: AI Interview Coach & Audio/Voice CBT Simulator
- Command: npm run test:interview -- --test-concurrency=1
- Target: 31 / 31 PASS (0 failures).
- Verification: Multi-tab session takeover, duration bounds, refresh recovery pointers, face-to-face text fallback, role/type question deduplication.

Stream 5: Cuba Executive Design System & 4-Portal Architecture
- Command: npm run test:design-system
- Target: 141 / 141 PASS (0 failures across 28 suites).
- Verification: Candidate, Employer, Enterprise, and Admin consoles; Google M3 / Cuba glassmorphic tokens; unique nav aria-label landmarks; AI quota ring honesty (zero fake numbers).

Stream 6: Hermetic Playwright Real-DOM Browser Crawl
- Command: npm run test:dir048:browser
- Target: 8 / 8 PASS (0 failures, expected 8, flaky 0) across 375px mobile, 768px tablet, 1280px desktop viewports.
- Verification: Zero native dialogs (window.alert/confirm/prompt); zero 'Invalid Date', NaN, or undefined strings in DOM; uniform gutters (<1400px); axe-core WCAG 2.1 AA in light AND dark mode.

Stream 7: Production Vite Bundle & Static Linting
- Command: npm run build && npm run lint
- Target: Build EXIT 0 (clean asset hashing, bundle compilation); ESLint 0 errors (0 fatal errors).

Stream 8: Protected Frozen Invariants & Template Integrity
- Verification:
  a) git diff e314f715 -- backend/services/aiRuntime.js must be strictly 0 bytes.
  b) node scripts/dir047-template-census.mjs must verify all 51 CV templates + 4 cover templates exist with 0 unmatched families.
  c) node scripts/dir047-latency-census.mjs must verify 0 simulated latency offenders.

### 4. ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA & EVIDENCE SUBMISSION
- AC-1: Remote environment cleanly cloned and configured with all required runtimes (Node, MariaDB, Playwright).
- AC-2: All 8 verification streams executed from first principles and documented with full console output logs.
- AC-3: Zero source code regressions or drift on protected frozen files (aiRuntime.js, resume templates).
- AC-4: Formal Master Certification Report compiled with test pass tallies, execution times, and SHA-256 evidence hashes.
- AC-5: Code committed and pushed to git remote upon certification.
invariants: ZERO TRUST: Independent proof required; no relying on prior logs or claims.
FROZEN CODE: backend/services/aiRuntime.js git diff vs e314f715 must remain strictly 0 bytes.
FROZEN TEMPLATES: All 51 resume templates and 4 cover letters must remain 100% intact.
REAL RUNTIME: Live MariaDB database and live headless browser execution mandatory (zero mocks).
acceptanceCriteria: AC-1: Remote environment cleanly configured with Node, live MariaDB, and Playwright.
AC-2: Security static suite passes 67/67 with 0 errors.
AC-3: Backend integration suite passes 892/892 on live MariaDB with 0 errors.
AC-4: Frontend product suite passes 729/729 with 0 errors.
AC-5: Interview coach suite passes 31/31 with --test-concurrency=1.
AC-6: Cuba design system suite passes 141/141 with 0 errors.
AC-7: Playwright real-DOM UAT passes 8/8 across 375px, 768px, and 1280px viewports.
AC-8: Vite production build exits 0 and ESLint reports 0 fatal errors.
AC-9: aiRuntime.js diff vs e314f715 is 0 bytes and template census matches 51 CVs / 4 covers.
AC-10: Master Certification Handover Report submitted with full evidence.
